Official references and assessment criteria

Readiness Checklist (7 Criteria), Cognitive Coverage & Matrix of the 107 Skills

Track the 7 independent, non-compensatory maturity gates (a high domain does not make up for another below 75%; the alternatives avoid length cues and absolute words), inspect the cognitive coverage report (8 dimensions), and export/import your progress as versioned JSON (`schemaVersion: 3`) with protection against accidental loss.

Phase 1 · Diagnostic (1 day)

Gap Mapping

Phase 2 · Fundamentals (5–7 days)

Phase 3 · Decisions (4–6 days)

Flowcharts + 16 Architectures

Cheatsheets + Gate ≥80%
